=== COLUMN 2 ===
Welcome to the
23rd Annual
'Rex Mays Classic
.
June 4, 1972
Dear Race Fan;
TRADITION - the one-mile oval Wisconsin State Fair Speedway literally drips
with tradition.
The classic mile oval — a configuration that dates back to the dawn of the 20th
century.
A covered grandstand — something that few of today's new race tracks bother with.
First class racing — synonymous with Milwaukee, the best in the country, USAC
Championship Trail racing.
Timing — the first race on the Trail after Indy, the excitement couldn't be greater.
TO THE MINUTE — the newest cars in the racing world, fast, innovative styling,
a kaleidoscope of colors.
Best — the best safety crew in the country, bar none. The Milwaukee operation is
professional in every respect.
YOU - the race fan, the most important ingredient on this recipe. The Wisconsin
State Fair Speedway couldn't have any tradition without your loyal support. We hearti-
ly thank you and pledge our utmost efforts to keep the Milwaukee tradition alive for
many years to come.
Sincerely,
John Kaishian, Tom Marchese
Co-Race Directors
WISCONSIN AUTO RACING, INC.
Armin Krueger, Russ Lake, John Kozy, Wayne Doebling, Bob Lewis, Frank Kern,
